evidence: Initializes a context helper from the global object, copies a one-byte selector-19 value into the input record at +0xa1, then queries selector 0x13; when that status equals 4 it reads the associated value and writes a byte at +0xa0, otherwise writes 0xff. Behavior is limited to these visible result-byte writes; no indexed callers. decompiled/main/main_0086.c:27258-27279,27284-27286.

Reads a value through global-object access and helper calls, then returns whether mask 0x3000000000000 is nonzero at decompiled/main/main_0124.c:17549-17579. The underlying global field and meaning of its two bits are not established, so left unnamed.

Returns false unless context selector 20 equals 4, then reads auxiliary 16-bit values and evaluates several comparisons before returning a boolean at decompiled/main/main_0056.c:24804-24824,24829-24834. Callers include format_care_package_item_value_text at main_0086.c:30601-30602, but the compared values and predicate meaning are not established; left unnamed.

Walks indices 0 through 0xd06 using the table at 0x700227e000+0x6c0 and the indexed-entry lookup helper. For available entries it may call a helper that clears bit 15 at object offset +0x24, then clears bit 7 there directly; exact object/domain name is unknown. decompiled/main/main_0052.c:22922-22947; delegated bit-15 mask clear at decompiled/main/main_0057.c:43153-43159. Its indexed caller invokes this sweep directly at decompiled/main/main_0058.c:28968-28972.

When the callback/result inputs are present it calls a helper and carries its return through; otherwise it creates a fallback result and dispatches through a function pointer loaded at object offset +0xd8. In either case it clears global byte 0x7003ae9000+0x4bc and calls update_season_record_detail_state with the result. decompiled/main/main_0088.c:41060-41087. No indexed callers.
